left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Is this made from actual Dubai Chocolate or pistachios?
No. This is a flavor-inspired formulation. It does not contain actual Dubai chocolate, pastries, or food products.
Is it suitable for individuals with nut allergies?
Yes. While inspired by natural pistachio flavor, the formulation is designed without allergenic nut ingredients.
Should I subscribe to this bundle?
This is a limited edition release, so it’s best suited as a one-time purchase. You’re welcome to purchase multiple bundles while available.
Is this suitable for both children and adults?
Yes. The formulation is designed for all ages.
What’s the difference between fluoride and non-fluoride?
The fluoride option includes fluoride along with Hydroxamin. The non-fluoride option uses Hydroxamin without fluoride. Both are designed to support daily oral care-choose based on your preference.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html: 1. Brush with a pea-sized amount for 2 minutes (morning and night) 2. Rinse with mouthwash for 60 seconds 3. Spit out—avoid rinsing with water afterward for best results 4. Use consistently as part of your daily oral care routine

reviews.title: Great unique products!
reviews.body: This is the best tasting mouthwash and toothpaste I have ever used! When I found out that most mouthwashes in the market have a low pH (Why?Just why??) I was shocked! When I was trying to find one with a high pH and that contained hydroxyapatite, Supermouth became the only logical answer! Add to it the fact that they came up with a Dubai Chocolate flavor no less and I had to have it! Haha! As for the toothpaste, I could either find ones that had hydroxyapatite OR fluoride, not both! After, I found the mouthwash and started browsing around the website, I was thrilled to find out that they had a Dubai Chocolate flavored toothpaste as well, with both fluoride and hydroxyapatite! I have used these products back to back almost every day since then! Not only do they make my teeth very happy, but they taste absolutely delicious! Bravo, Supermouth for coming up with such a genius idea!

reviews.name: Colton
reviews.title: In Love with SuperMouth? Chocolate?! Duba-I Think So!
reviews.body:
I was already expecting to love this product simply because I already love Dubai chocolate and I always hyper analyze product ingredients and look for reviews etc. For anything I put into my body or that is skin-related (and toothpaste definitely fits into both categories, looking at you SLS... or, not in these products!). The ingredient list is absolute All-Star lineup of knockout ingredients that really shine together (pun intended), and speaks volumes about this company as a whole. The one-two punch of fluoride and Nano-hydroxyapatite is huge by itself, but it doesn't stop there. It's paired with xylitol and even MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), which are both top-tier ingredients for overall oral health and for extra penetration and anti-inflammatory properties, respectfully. Some people might see the price tag expensive when compared to regular toothpaste, but this is anything but regular toothpaste and is actually very competitively priced in comparison to other alternatives, especially ones that pair fluoride with Nano-hydroxyapatite in one toothpaste! I'm very poor (haha! 😅) And I researched ingredients as well as prices from tons of different toothpastes and different brands, and I was genuinely searching for some type of catch that I am grateful I never found! It sits at the mid-tier for premium toothpaste pricing but with amazing ingredients that are clean and clearly indicate how meticulously these products were thought of and researched before they were made and sold. The ingredients are even fungal-acne safe! Well, The lowest two ingredients (cranberry seed oil and sodium methyl cocoyl taurate aren't technically FA safe, but it's virtually non-existent since it's going in your mouth instead of used topically and you spit it out with virtually no contact time. Especially for most people but also for fungal acne concerns, this is a huge step up compared to SLS!) Do you know how hard it is to find skincare products that don't contain a plethora of FA triggers that are much more likely to greatly increases the potential, if not guaranteed, feeding of the malassezia yeast because they go directly on your skin?! Sadly, far too few. I believe a toothpaste should definitely fall under the same umbrella of products you wouldn't put on your skin without researching the actual ingredients that are used, oral care products all too often fly under that radar.

I recently purchased a Soladey5 Ionic Toothbrush (displayed in the attached image) to pair with this SuperMouth combo, so I've genuinely been looking forward to trying out all of these new products. The toothbrush took more getting used to the toothpaste or mouthwash as it was immediate that I took to both of those! For those unaware, the toothbrush utilizes negative ions delivered through the bristles from light hitting the solar panels on the front and back to send through the toothbrush bristles into your mouth to help loosen plaque. The metal part above the solar panels is where you need to hold the toothbrush as you brush your teeth as your body works as the conduit to send the negative ions through the titanium rod in the brush head that gets generated from the light in the water that hits the titanium rod. Yeah, it's a lot of science but just like the toothpaste and mouthwash from SuperMouth, It's also science-backed! They claim you can brush your teeth with just water alone to clean your teeth but even if true, fluoride is very important for oral health and the other ingredients within these two products are super beneficial, so pairing them together was the obvious answer.

The taste of these products are amazing and it's honestly difficult to articulate great it is, but I'll try. While the inherently conditioned expectation most everyone has that mint equates to clean and fresh might negatively work towards enforcing that bias, which could result in the initial creation of a self-fulfilling prophecy of it being a terrible experience, I believe that this dynamic can also result in expectations being blown through the roof due to the stark contrast of the reality that is how unexpectedly refreshing this Dubai chocolate flavor is! (Phew, talk about a SuperMouthful! 😏 *crickets chirping* 😮‍💨)

I went into this having high hopes as I thought I would enjoy the flavor no matter what. The last mouthful of a sentence I made is mainly my opinion on how most people might think of a chocolate flavor for a toothpaste. Even with going trying this with a positive light, I was still completely blown away and shocked without amazing the flavor was and how the flavor extremely natural. Not only was it unexpectedly natural feeling and tasty. I genuinely don't want to use a different flavored toothpaste! (Here's looking at you now, Mr. Limited Edition)

All in all, this product it has great ingredients that are science-backed and from this one purchase that I've made of their products, I can already tell that genuine care and effort was put into their products and that's, unfortunately, not something you can say about as many companies as one should. If you were, you were like me and you were on the fence of trying to upgrade your oral Care regimen, especially if you are looking for a combination toothpaste with fluoride and Nano-hydroxyapatite that isn't $30+ per tube, then save yourself the trouble and try this company out. Trust me, I've researched higher quality products with smart ingredients that would amount to far more time spent that one should have probably spent on such an endeavor (lol), so do yourself a favor and take advantage of all the research I've done and at the very least, do so. Favor and give this company and their products will try! Will I purchase again? Most definitely! Will I recommend? Oh yes! How will I recommend? Only by word of SuperMouth. 😏😅 *sees self out*
